arguments.description: Premium brutal but restrained dark-fantasy D&D dragon-forged release-notes poster frame. One continuous full-canvas near-black background with blackened iron, dark stone, worn gold, tiny crimson gems, subtle violet disk-rift light and restrained dragon ornaments around the outside and the central divider. Leave these proportional areas completely empty, dark, calm and readable for later content: upper-left release badge; upper-left brand logo beneath it; upper-right subtitle; full-width intro strip; two large equal body columns below; full-width footer strip. Decorative metal, dragon heads, gems, spikes, seams, smoke, characters, weapons and bright highlights must stay outside those interiors. Draw only the final frame/layout layer around the empty zones. No text, numbers, letters, pseudo-text, logo, watermark, UI labels or placeholder glyphs anywhere. Premium, elegant, epic, strict, beautiful, not loud, not cluttered, not over-detailed.
